A.name: Stack A: Sovereign Omnichannel Closer
A.tagline: Postiz publishes, Chatwoot catches every DM, n8n routes, Ollama writes the reply, Twenty CRM logs the deal.

B.name: Stack B: Agentic Low-Code Closer
B.tagline: Mixpost publishes, a Flowise AI agent qualifies and replies, Activepieces automates hand-offs, EspoCRM tracks the pipeline.

postiz.name: Postiz
postiz.first_run: Open the link and click 'Sign up' to create the first local admin account.

chatwoot.name: Chatwoot
chatwoot.role: Omnichannel DM inbox (FB, IG, WhatsApp, X, Telegram, web chat)
chatwoot.first_run: First visit shows the onboarding form; create the super-admin account, then add inboxes under Settings > Inboxes.

n8n.name: n8n
n8n.role: Workflow automation glue between every tool
n8n.first_run: Create the owner account, then Workflows > Import from File > /automations/stack_a_dm_closer.n8n.json.

ollama-webui.name: Ollama + Open WebUI
ollama-webui.role: Local LLM that writes 24/7 DM sales replies
ollama-webui.first_run: No login (WEBUI_AUTH disabled locally). The llama3.2:3b model is pulled automatically on first launch (~2 GB).

twenty.name: Twenty CRM
twenty.role: System of record for leads and deals closed from DMs
twenty.first_run: Create a workspace on first visit. Settings > APIs & Webhooks > create an API key for the closer automation.

mixpost.name: Mixpost
mixpost.role: Self-hosted Buffer alternative for scheduling and publishing
mixpost.first_run: Open the link; Mixpost shows its installer/register screen for the first admin user.

flowise.name: Flowise
flowise.role: Visual AI agent builder for the DM qualification and closing bot
flowise.first_run: Create the local admin account, then Chatflows > Load > /automations/stack_b_flowise_closer.json.

activepieces.name: Activepieces
activepieces.role: No-code automation (Zapier alternative) for hand-offs and follow-ups
activepieces.first_run: Sign up with any email on first visit (local instance, no verification).

espocrm.name: EspoCRM
espocrm.role: Lightweight CRM for leads, opportunities and follow-up tasks
espocrm.first_run: Log in with username 'admin' and the generated password shown on the hub card (stored in tools/espocrm/.env).
